items.source: Only repositories annotated with @(Repository)RestResource are exposed, unless their exported flag is set to false.
items.translation: 只有标注了@(Repository)RestResource的仓库才会被暴露，除非其exported标志设置为false。

items.source: To customize the configuration, register a RepositoryRestConfigurer and implement or override the configure…-methods relevant to your use case.
items.translation: 要自定义配置，请注册一个 `RepositoryRestConfigurer` 并实现或重写与您用例相关的 `configure…` 方法。

items.source: Spring Data REST uses a RepositoryDetectionStrategy to determine whether a repository is exported as a REST resource. The RepositoryDiscoveryStrategies enumeration includes the following values:
items.translation: Spring Data REST 使用 RepositoryDetectionStrategy 来确定是否将仓库导出为 REST 资源。RepositoryDiscoveryStrategies 枚举包含以下值：

items.source: Exposes all public repository interfaces but considers the exported flag of @(Repository)RestResource.
items.translation: 公开所有公共存储库接口，但会考虑 `@(Repository)RestResource` 的 `exported` 标志。

items.source: To install Spring Data REST alongside your existing Spring MVC application, you need to include the appropriate MVC configuration. Spring Data REST configuration is defined in a class called RepositoryRestMvcConfiguration and you can import that class into your application’s configuration.
items.translation: 要在现有的 Spring MVC 应用程序中安装 Spring Data REST，您需要包含相应的 MVC 配置。 Spring Data REST 的配置定义在一个名为 `RepositoryRestMvcConfiguration` 的类中，您可以将该类导入到您的应用程序配置中。

items.source: Make sure you also configure Spring Data repositories for the store you use. For details on that, see the reference documentation for the corresponding Spring Data module.
items.translation: 请确保为所使用的存储配置 Spring Data 仓库。有关详细信息，请参阅相应 Spring Data 模块的参考文档：Spring Data 对应模块。

items.source: From this point, you can customize Spring Data REST with various options.
items.translation: 从这一点开始，您可以通过各种选项自定义 Spring Data REST。

items.source: Spring Data REST is itself a Spring MVC application and is designed in such a way that it should integrate with your existing Spring MVC applications with little effort. An existing (or future) layer of services can run alongside Spring Data REST with only minor additional work.
items.translation: Spring Data REST 本身是一个 Spring MVC 应用程序，其设计方式使其能够以极小的工作量与您现有的 Spring MVC 应用程序进行集成。现有的（或未来的）服务层可以与 Spring Data REST 并行运行，仅需少量额外工作即可实现。

items.source: When you use Spring Boot, Spring Data REST gets configured automatically.
items.translation: 使用 Spring Boot 时，Spring Data REST 会自动配置。

items.source: This section covers the basic settings that you can manipulate when you configure a Spring Data REST application, including:
items.translation: 本节涵盖在配置 Spring Data REST 应用程序时可操纵的基本设置，包括：

items.source: Exposes all repositories independently of type visibility and annotations.
items.translation: 独立于类型可见性和注解，暴露所有仓库。

items.source: Only public repositories annotated are exposed.
items.translation: 仅公开标注的仓库会被暴露。

items.source: By default, Spring Data REST serves up REST resources at the root URI, '/'. There are multiple ways to change the base path.
items.translation: 默认情况下，Spring Data REST 会在根 URI "/" 处提供 REST 资源。有多种方法可以更改基础路径。

items.translation: 更改每页显示项目数量的默认值。

items.translation: 更改单页中的最大项目数量。

items.translation: 更改用于选择页面的查询参数名称。

items.source: change the name of the query parameter for the number of items to show in a page
items.translation: 将查询参数名称从“每页显示的项目数量”更改为其他名称。

items.source: change the name of the query parameter for sorting
items.translation: 更改用于排序的查询参数名称。

items.source: change the default media type to use when none is specified
items.translation: 更改未指定时使用的默认媒体类型。

items.source: change whether a body should be returned when creating a new entity
items.translation: 创建新实体时，是否返回该实体的主体。

items.source: change whether a body should be returned when updating an entity
items.translation: 更改更新实体时是否应返回该实体。

items.translation: 此时，您还必须配置您的主数据存储。

items.source: This step is unnecessary if you use Spring Boot’s auto-configuration. Spring Boot automatically enables Spring Data REST when you include spring-boot-starter-data-rest and, in your list of dependencies, your app is flagged with either @SpringBootApplication or @EnableAutoConfiguration.
items.translation: 如果您使用 Spring Boot 的自动配置功能，则此步骤是多余的。当您包含 spring-boot-starter-data-rest 依赖项时，Spring Boot 会自动启用 Spring Data REST；此外，如果您的应用程序在依赖列表中添加了 @SpringBootApplication 或 @EnableAutoConfiguration 注解，该功能也会被激活。

items.source: You need not supply the version number if you use the Spring Boot Gradle plugin or the Spring Boot Maven plugin.
items.translation: 如果您使用 Spring Boot Gradle 插件 或 Spring Boot Maven 插件，则无需提供版本号。

items.source: In general, Spring Data REST does not add functionality to a given data store. This means that, by definition, it should work with any Spring Data project that supports the repository programming model. The data stores listed above are the ones for which we have written integration tests to verify that Spring Data REST works with them.
items.translation: 一般来说，Spring Data REST 不会为给定的数据存储添加功能。这意味着，根据定义，它应该能够与任何支持仓库编程模型的 Spring Data 项目协同工作。上面列出的数据存储是我们编写了集成测试以验证 Spring Data REST 与其兼容性的对象。
